title: Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16489v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but an effective training run requires considerable resources. Reusing the computation acquired through RL across models would extend the value of that training. We propose GrowRL, an RL method that organizes learned updates into compact computational pathways through structural growth. GrowRL freezes the pretrained backbone and adds an independent causal attention branch and a feed-forward network branch at each Transformer layer. Zero-initialized output projections preserve the pretrained policy at initialization, and RL updates only the added pathways. The learned pathways remain explicit after training, allowing transfer to structurally compatible target models and subsequent adaptation with the target backbone frozen. translated_title: 面向大语言模型强化学习的路径生长与迁移方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）能够显著提升大语言模型的推理能力，但一次有效的训练需要消耗大量资源。在不同模型之间复用通过强化学习获得的计算，可以延长该训练的价值。我们提出了GrowRL，一种通过结构生长将学习到的更新组织为紧凑计算路径的强化学习方法。GrowRL冻结预训练主干网络，并在每个Transformer层添加一个独立的因果注意力分支和一个前馈网络分支。零初始化的输出投影确保初始化时保持预训练策略不变，而强化学习仅更新新增的路径。训练完成后，学习到的路径保持显式形式，从而可以迁移到结构兼容的目标模型，并在目标主干网络冻结的情况下进行后续适配。该架构还支持多个额外路径的顺序迁移。通过保持学习到的注意力（原文在此处截断）
tldr: GrowRL通过冻结预训练主干并在每层添加零初始化的注意力与前馈网络分支，将强化学习的更新组织为显式计算路径，实现训练成果在不同模型间的迁移复用。
en_tdlr: GrowRL organizes RL updates into explicit, zero-initialized attention and feed-forward pathway branches on a frozen pretrained backbone, enabling the learned RL pathways to be transferred across structurally compatible models.
